issued_to: Claude Code agent (Claude Opus 5.5), agent session of 2026-10-09 in this repository

source.form: Written brief given by the operator in the agent session on 2026-10-09, titled 'CO.PRE.PAN 3.0 - Comprehensive Source Qualification, Registry Expansion & Intake Readiness'. The brief is quoted, not paraphrased. This record is written by the commissioned agent from that brief: it is the agent's transcription of the operator's commission, not a document signed by the operator, and it grants nothing the brief does not. The outlets are those the rules of scripts/build_qualification_proposal.py registered from the repository's own inventory (config/source_discovery/qualification_dispositions_2026-10-09.json), together with the outlets registered before that have no verified acquisition and no hold.
authorising_clauses: Dieser Auftrag autorisiert einen zeitlich auf diesen Run begrenzten, technisch kontrollierten Qualifizierungsbetrieb für sämtliche bereits im Repository dokumentierten Outlet-Kandidaten.

Die Autorisierung umfasst: [...] begrenzte echte HTTP-Requests an zulässige Quellen; Erweiterung und Korrektur von Registry-Einträgen; Registrierung qualifizierter Outlets; [...] begrenzte Artikelaufnahme als Nachweis; Tests, Preservation, Replay und Evaluation; versionierte Baselines und Delegationsdatensätze; temporäres Arming und automatisches Disarming; Dokumentation, Commits und Push.

Kein `ARM`, keine manuelle Digest-Eingabe und keine zusätzliche projektspezifische Freigabe für Tätigkeiten verlangen, die dieser Auftrag ausdrücklich umfasst. Die Autorisierung muss in einem versionierten Datensatz mit eingefrorenem Scope und nachvollziehbarer Herkunft dokumentiert werden.

Für diesen umfassenden Qualifizierungs-Run gelten als harte zusätzliche Obergrenzen: maximal 4 Item-Requests je Outlet; maximal 8 sonstige HTTP-Requests je Outlet, einschließlich Robots, Discovery-Dokumenten, Expansion und Redirects; maximal 1.800 HTTP-Transportrequests insgesamt; höchstens eine gleichzeitig laufende Anfrage je Publisher-Origin; grundsätzlich mindestens 10 Sekunden Abstand zwischen Anfragen an denselben Origin; bei Rate-Limits, 429, 503 oder anderen Belastungsindikatoren angemessener Backoff beziehungsweise Hold.
Wenn das Gesamtbudget erreicht ist, ausstehende Quellen als nicht geprüft ausweisen, nicht still auslassen und nicht nachträglich neue Budgets erzeugen.

Grenzen: Keine allgemeine Production Activation. Kein unbegrenztes Crawling. Keine zusätzlichen Publisher außerhalb des vorhandenen Kandidateninventars ohne gesonderte Autorisierung. Keine Umgehung von Bot-Challenges, Captchas, Paywalls oder Zugriffssperren. Bestehende Holds respektieren. Keine eigenmächtige Ausweitung bestehender Research-/Robots-Overrides. `co_el_tiempo` bleibt bis zur gesonderten Lizenz-/TDM-Entscheidung ausgeschlossen.

actions_authorized: turn external_acquisition on for exactly one canary per wave and off again
run the tests on the arming commit, build the canary baseline of that commit and freeze it by its digest under this record
make the requests the canary driver makes for a wave's outlets within the wave's limits: robots files, the registered channel documents and what they name, at most four item pages per outlet
preserve, verify, replay, measure, commit and push the evidence
not_authorized: any outlet outside the five waves; co_el_tiempo; any outlet that is not registered; any publisher outside the repository's inventory

any request to an origin under a hold (hn_proceso_digital, ve_efecto_cocuyo, cu_cubanet, ni_articulo66, and any origin a run of this record comes to hold); no way around a bot challenge, a captcha, a paywall, a registration wall or a robots decision
any request beyond a wave's limits; a second canary of a wave; more than 1800 transport requests under this record in all (the five waves allow 1164)
articles listed only by an HTML listing without a reviewed allow rule: the listing answers are preserved and nothing they name is requested
a 12- or 24-hour intake, a scheduler, a repeated acquisition, general production activation, a change of the acquisition policy other than the switch
any change to a frozen baseline, a receipt, an earlier authorisation record or a decision record of the past; any claim of a human confirmation
holds_in_force: hn_proceso_digital, ve_efecto_cocuyo, cu_cubanet, ni_articulo66: bot challenges of 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; in no wave; not contacted
a hold the driver derives from a preserved answer of any run applies at once and is not lifted by this record
the research-TDM override of CPD-0017 applies as it is in the policy in force; this record does not widen it
technical_gates: clean working tree and HEAD equal to origin/main before arming
this record tracked, touched by exactly one commit, unmodified and pushed
every outlet of the wave registered
the full test suite passes on the arming commit
the baseline is READY_TO_FREEZE with nothing blocking, pins this record's id and digest and the wave, and is frozen once per wave
the canary's budget is capped by the wave's limits (CPD-0024); a wave is at most 24 outlets (CPD-0025)
the policy's pace: at least ten seconds between requests to one origin, a stated crawl delay as the binding minimum, one attempt per request
preflight READY; the driver's own refusals (drift, pushed HEAD, empty spool, budgets, robots, holds) unchanged
verification after the run: read-back, fixity, replay without network, receipt re-derived from evidence, budget respected
disarming read back in the file, in HEAD and on origin/main
stop_conditions: the canary is not exactly the wave's outlets, or a limit of its budget exceeds the wave's
the policy version is not one this record names, or the record is out of date
the wave already has a frozen baseline
a refusal by the agent environment's own permission layer: recorded, not worked around
disarming: After a wave's canary, whatever its outcome, external_acquisition is set to disabled, committed and pushed, and the state is read back from the file, HEAD and origin/main. A run that cannot show this ends as not disarmed, never as done.
decisions: the thirteen outlets with verified acquisition and no finding to check are in no wave: their evidence is used as it is
ec_primicias is in a wave although it is verified: its acquisition of 2026-10-09 went by a route since closed (F9), and its sitemap route has not been taken
ec_el_universo (F11, apex origin added), uy_montevideo_portal (F12, nameless query kept), py_la_nacion (F8) and gt_lahora (F10) are in a wave to confirm their repairs on the real servers
a wave that stops is not repeated under this record; its outlets are reported as not tested
